notes.title: The first level of the game DEMO is finally complete!
notes.content: Since the first level serves as a tutorial and involves quite a bit of text and exploration logic, it took longer than expected to complete. Due to numerous updates, I recommend starting over. Apologies for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Demo Update - Bug Fixes
notes.content: Fixed bugs in Demo Scene 1 (Please note that original save data may encounter compatibility issues; it is recommended to start a new game).

notes.title: Demo Update: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Addressed some guidance issues and resolved the occasional unresponsive firepit interaction.
(Note: Previous save files cannot be carried over. Please start a new save. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience!)

notes.title: Quest Girl DEMO is Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079435/bb0ff99820bc528783aced929027332b08149ef7.png[/img]

Dear Players:
I’m thrilled to announce that after countless late nights and brainstorming sessions, the DEMO version of Quest Girl is finally here! You can now download and experience this mysterious puzzle-adventure game for free.

The DEMO currently includes the initial level. Since this project is a solo effort, there might be some bugs or issues—thank you for your understanding and patience. Your feedback will be invaluable! As development progresses, future updates to the DEMO will include exciting new features and levels, such as swimming, battling monsters, catching fireflies, fishing, and more, just like in the teaser video.

I look forward to having you join this adventure!
